raw_segments.text: Lear, let it be so, thy truth then be thy dour. For by the sacred radiance of the sun,
the mysteries of Hecate and the night, by all the operation of the orbs, from whom we
do exist and cease to be, here I disclaim all my paternal care, propinquity and property
of blood, and as a stranger to my heart and me hold thee from this forever.
The barbarous Scythian, or he that makes his generation messes to gorge his appetite, shall
to my bosom be as well-nabored, pitied, and relieved, as thou my sometime daughter.
